As a first-generation college student, I know how hard it is to learn when all you’re worrying about is where you’ll get your next meal.

Access to critical nutrition is a matter of equity & it’s why we must pass my #EATSAct.

Thanks @castudentaid for your advocacy on this issue! https://t.co/Eno7wcYiNt

Tomorrow, the @WhiteHouse will host the first conference on hunger, nutrition, & health in over 50 years!

Ahead of this event, I led a letter to @POTUS w/ @SenGillibrand @RepJoshHarder @RepJimmyPanetta thanking the Biden administration for taking steps to end student hunger. 1/2 https://t.co/SNGrQTu1O9

Food insecurity is a growing crisis on college campuses across the nation.

That’s why I introduced the #EATSAct, which would update SNAP eligibility rules for college students — and I’m glad to see that @POTUS agrees with me! 2/2

https://t.co/nL4i5ZxL0N

Today is a big day in the fight against food insecurity.

The @WhiteHouse is hosting its first Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health in over 50 years — where @POTUS will announce his commitment to ending hunger in the U.S. by 2030. 1/3

We know preventative care saves lives.

From early cancer detection to HIV prevention to newborn screenings, these services are critical to prevent a diagnosis from becoming a death sentence. 

And by identifying issues early, you’re saving money AND lives in the long run. 2/

Black mothers deserve nothing less than equitable healthcare. The reports from Cedars-Sinai, though shocking, sadly reflect a pattern.
 
Congress needs to pass @RepUnderwood's MOMNIBUS bill which directly tackles the racial disparities in maternal health.

After having Hodge, Mary experienced postpartum preeclampsia—a life threatening condition, often missed because the symptoms are shrugged off or ignored.

By people telling their stories on #BumpDay we hope more moms AND dads can become aware of what to look out for & save lives!

Gov. Abbott's treatment of immigrants is not only barbaric but defies American values & laws. I signed a letter with my colleagues urging @POTUS to act swiftly to end his cruelty.

Seeing the admin step in is a relief; Gov. Abbott needs to be stopped immediately.

They're making a huge impact, providing 100k+ meals/month to vulnerable seniors & residents. Beyond the healthy meals, they offer shelf-stable food & wellness checks – going above & beyond for #CA34! https://t.co/jvhtyCUzjw

This tentative contract between @WGAWest, @WGAEast and AMPTP is a victory for the guild and all dedicated workers.

When we organize, we win.
